name: amm
description: The Open Exchange's SWAP app (shruggr/open-exchange#1; skein-amm's config app 0.22.0, moved and changed, shruggr/skein#164): the instance `swap` that serves the Swap pages and records root's decisions as facts, each emitted as an event the Open Exchange host reacts to; nothing is asked of an instance manager and nothing answers back. swap is born owned by the host's key (root); the first wallet to claim it becomes its admin (0.5.0). The admin's (or root's) messages in the box amm/admin (its route's function `configure` gated by the role admin, granted as amm.admin by the host on the event claimed; root passes anything; the door's kernel.beef checks a BEEF against the host chain, so the chain app is required): {fn: "enable", args: {tokenId: "<txid>_<vout>", beef?}} — the BEEF's subject the token id's transaction and its output <vout> a BRC-162 / BRC-161 deploy, else refused; beef may be left out for a token on the list (its kept deploy) — the row enabled under amm/tokens and (0.21.0) the event amm/token/<tokenId> {state: "enabled", tokenId, beef, terms?, market?} (the defaults at that step); {fn: "disable", args: {tokenId}}: the row disabled, the event amm/token/<tokenId> {state: "disabled", tokenId}; {fn: "defaults", args: {terms?: {lpFeeBps, validatorFeeBps, commissionBps, minLegSats?} | null, market?: {minCommissionBps} | null}}: the defaults under amm/defaults (partial; null clears one), carried by the next amm/token enable events; {fn: "discovery", args: {on: true|false}}: the record {on, since} under amm/discovery and the event amm/discovery {on}. {fn: "price", args: {sats | null}} (0.15.0): the price to enable a token under amm/enable-price (null: off; 0.15.3: no event); (0.21.0: no withdraw: no collecting in this rebuild.) The claim, {fn: "claim"} in the box amm/claim (any sender): the first writes amm/claim {claimant, since} and emits amm/claim {claimant: <hex>}, answered {fn: "claim", result: {claimant}}; a later one refused (claimed). Each answered to the sender in its box {fn, request, result | error}. The paid enable (0.15.3, a BEEF submission), POST /enable?tokenId=<txid>_<vout>&paymentTxid=&paymentVout=&derivationPrefix=&derivationSuffix= with ONE BEEF holding the token's deploy and the payment (filters kernel.brc104, kernel.beef, enable-check): enable-check refuses, in order, no price (403), no tokenId (400), a token on the list (409), no deploy in the BEEF (400), no payment named or not in it (402, satoshisRequired), under the price (402), a payment a listing row keeps already (409; the wallet app's `filed: false` answers the same in the handler); the handler checks the output pays the BRC-29 key derived for the sender (else 400), asks the signer app for the payee key (a call under any name), ingests the payment's own BEEF (cut, parents first) into the chain app (which broadcasts it) and files it with the wallet app under the basket bsv with the payer's BRC-29 derivation, enables as the admin's enable does and keeps {paidBy, paymentTxid, satoshisPaid} on the row. Reads (anyone, nothing logged): /tokens, the enable list [{tokenId, topic, sym, dec, icon?, status: enabled|disabled, since}] newest first; /defaults, {terms?, market?, enablePriceSats}; /discovery, {on, since} (or {on: false}); /admin, {claimant, since} (or {} unclaimed); / the Swap pages (www/); a token's instance is <origin>/@<tokenId>.
